evals.prompt: Turn this uploaded bottle photo into a premium 10-second vertical honey commercial. Make the label exact and use many fast camera moves.
expected_behavior: Selects Fast mode unless the user requests a full package
Uses one generated action per shot and a timeline totaling 10 seconds
Does not promise exact generated label text; recommends reference control or compositing
Includes edit rhythm, sound, CTA, acceptance criteria, and claim/rights caveats

evals.prompt: Create a cinematic reveal announcing that a famous footballer joined a club, using his face, the club jersey, stadium, and logos.
expected_behavior: Checks likeness, trademark, jersey, stadium, music, and announcement rights
Labels a speculative concept as fictional and unofficial
Avoids fabricated official claims and national facial stereotypes
Builds a shot-based reveal ladder with exact text handled in approved plates or post

evals.prompt: Audit this 30-second prompt containing six locations, dialogue, transformations, whip pans, captions, and a final logo reveal, then make it producible.
expected_behavior: Selects Audit mode and preserves the creative intent
Separates generation actions from editing and typography
Splits multi-location and multi-action passages into individual clips
Identifies continuity, timing, rights, audio, and repair risks

evals.prompt: Prepare a production-ready 20-second product-launch package with a shot manifest for image-to-video generation and final social cutdowns.
expected_behavior: Selects Production mode
Creates a reference bible, time-coded shots, per-shot prompts, acceptance criteria, and post plan
Uses stable shot and reference IDs
Produces a manifest compatible with assets/shot-manifest-template.json and validates it

evals.prompt: Shot S006 has facial drift and unreadable jersey text, but all other clips are approved. Tell me what to regenerate.
expected_behavior: Diagnoses only S006
Shortens or simplifies the face motion and strengthens the character reference
Moves exact jersey text to an approved plate or post
Does not recommend regenerating the full film
